usedFor: monday.com holds your boards and Pushwoosh sends alerts, so “Item Column Value Changes” runs “Send Push Notification”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Send Push Notification” in Pushwoosh
bestTemplate.why: A value change on a board reaches a segment as a push notification.

watchOut: “Item Column Value Changes” fires on any column edit, so expect one push per change.
